responsibility: This file supplies shared tree-construction utilities that sit just below the main gm2 expression and statement builders. It wraps GCC modify-expr construction and generic statement creation, builds call expressions with packed argument arrays, provides bit-test-and-jump helpers, and contains set-specific address/field/value accessors for small and large set representations, so it acts as a reusable support library for common tree-manipulation patterns.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the m2treelib group: it contains the reusable support code for call construction, modify expressions, statement wrappers, and set-field/address helpers, whereas m2treelib.h declares those native helpers and m2treelib.def exports the Modula-2 foreign interface.
